blocks.text: Instantly switch from chats to calls
Using Intercom for live chats? CXDYNAMIQ’s call widget lets you use the same chat window to manage voice interactions with your users.

Intercom is a software that creates a informing platform which allows organizations to communicate with imminent and existing clients within their app, on their website, social media and through email.In Intercom, REST API is a main building block to retrieve data, keep the information in sync, to make actions automatically, update data from own Intercom account, or to incorporate Intercom into products. Need help with integration ? get in touch with us for a free quote by filling out the Request a quote.
CXDYNAMIQ Auto dialers come packed with every tool and feature you need to run a successful campaign.
